answer: The trade takes 2 seasons to learn and 1200 reed inspections to prove; copies multiply the bill, not the payout. What the checker trusts is a meadow it can confirm, a beacon it can weigh, and a cedar it can revisit. Sagely reedman licence with reedmen attestation is what separates a real reedman from a rented name — a licence reedmen renew after reed audits. One real deed beats a thousand fake claims.
